claims.text: Visa FY2024 net revenue of USD 35,926 million vs FY2023 net revenue of USD 32,653 million implies year-over-year net revenue growth; the exact percentage is produced by the requested calculation below.

counterarguments.text: The figures are labeled as 'derived' facts rather than directly quoted from the 10-K, so they should be verified against the primary filing before relying on them.

citations.quotation: Visa 2024 SEC 10-K: derived net revenue facts

limitations: The source data is described as 'derived' rather than a direct quote from the SEC 10-K; figures should be reconciled to the original filing.
Only two fiscal years are provided, so the growth rate reflects a single annual comparison and cannot show trends.
No segment breakdown, currency-adjusted metrics, or drivers of revenue growth are provided.
Fiscal year end dates differ from calendar years (Sep 30 year-end), which matters when comparing to peers on calendar-year reporting.
No calculation result is supplied in the sources; the growth percentage itself is computed via the requested calculation and should be verified before use.
